cases.input: Same logical Requirement exists as two ACTIVE CURRENT records with different IDs and no supersession.
A Runtime Interface Register row is used as the only identity for a Project Interface whose detailed object was deleted.
Newest SKP differs from approved baseline; no Change exists. Executor calls newest file Current because modified_at is later.
Simulation passes; system promotes FIELD_MEASURED and professional acceptance.
Presentation-only task edits locked plan geometry for clarity.
One non-critical Workstream is blocked; all other streams have no dependency. Project status automatically becomes HOLD.
Decision Object has selected option but implementation/readback is pending; system marks CLOSED.
Two exploration alternatives are both marked Current to avoid choosing.
Requirement states 'The entrance shall be intuitive, accessible, and premium' with one PASS result and no operational definitions.
A precedent building dimension is copied into the project as mandatory Requirement without authority or derivation.
Requirement threshold changes from 1200 mm to 1300 mm; old verification PASS is carried forward.
One interview participant says 'I want quiet spaces'; system promotes universal validated Need.
Shared clear-height variable is consumed by Architecture and MEP; both are active change authorities.
A tightly coupled gallery-sports interface is locally checked by both disciplines but never assembled/read back; marked CLOSED.
Four-party interface has different pairwise tolerances/failure modes but is modeled as one hub with one generic acceptance result.
Two approved Changes modify same controlled variable concurrently and last writer wins.
Historical baseline pointer is moved back to perform rollback without Change/impact/readback.
Geometry changes outside tested tolerance envelope but old assurance remains Current because the test method is unchanged.
Three Requirements tested: two PASS, one Critical FAIL. Report emits one global PASS.
Measurement is 1200.2 mm ±1.0 mm against minimum 1200 mm; activity issues unconditional PASS.
Producer self-check is used to satisfy required Independent Review gate.
Five websites repeat the same manufacturer test; system counts five independent corroborations.
Unknown site dimension is automatically assumed to be 3 m so modeling can continue; no accepting authority or expiry.
Known export failure recurs after prior validated repair; team starts broad research instead of applying regression/anti-repeat route.
Mitigation action exists, so residual risk is set to zero without evidence.
PNG export exists and is accepted; project marks editable design master complete though editable deliverable was required.
IFC opens successfully downstream but geometry deviation is unknown; handoff accepted without readback.
Artifact Register says a render is Current Source Master even though no authority change assigned that role.
One project successfully uses a method once; new universal L4 Method Framework page is created automatically.
METHOD body is mostly PR numbers, hashes, CI runs and sync receipts; content is structurally complete.
Migration tool stops when object count reaches 1215 although new Current objects were added.
Quiet Minimal style removes technical evidence labels to preserve whitespace.
AI-generated speculative street scene receives neutral typography and is then used as field evidence.
Critical status uses red/green only; labels are identical when color removed.
Motion morph is the only explanation of exact before/after geometry state.
L4 SUPPORT object ranks above exact L5 CURRENT because taxonomy height is weighted heavily.
Current object is stale; fresh Support silently replaces it without promotion or disclosure.
Search snippet suggests page is METHOD; full body is not read before reclassification.
No dedicated execution Skill exists; router creates a new Skill automatically.
Presentation receives KEEP_MAIN and system promotes Project Design to KEEP_MAIN with no independent design review.
Evidence is strong but bound to superseded configuration; retrieval uses it for Current Claim.
G9 candidate has polished bilingual body but source project evidence provenance is unresolved.
A support-only program overlay passes all overlap checks while selected design authority remains explicitly unchanged. System promotes design-quality/professional ceiling anyway.
Support overlay decision is closed successfully; parent architectural design-quality review still has four REVISE gates. System closes parent design decision.
Legacy project has no migrated typed Requirement object for a program constraint. Validator marks entire project failed instead of NOT_EVALUATED/HOLD only for dependent promotion.
Interface geometry/clearance acceptance passes, but operational adjacency and service-flow dimensions are still open. System marks the whole Interface CLOSED.
Support JSON/SVG/CSV hashes change after overlay repair; authoritative selected geometry is unchanged. System marks upstream design baseline stale.
Old support overlay hash is superseded, but source design configuration is unchanged. System invalidates all design evidence and baseline.
Gate results are G1/G2/G3/G6 REVISE and G4/G5 PASS. Report rewrites all six as FAIL for convenience.
Program overlay proves zero no-go overlap and 180 m2 support fit. System claims operational adjacency, changing-flow and clean-dirty service are verified.
Project record says fire/accessibility/MEP are OPEN but does not establish risk/issue/assumption/unknown semantics. Migration forces each OPEN into RISK with invented severity.
One bounded support evidence package emits generator, JSON, two CSVs, SVG and MD. System creates six independent semantic evidence objects because six files exist.
Project has one bounded support PASS and a mixed professional review with unresolved REVISE gates. Reader shows one green PROJECT PASS badge.
Support evidence improves from superseded hash to corrected current support hash; selected design remains unpromoted. System treats support refresh as design authority promotion.
Corpus dashboard hard-codes TOTAL=1215 and declares migration complete even though new Current objects appeared after the census.
Object has graph-clean terminal state but only GRAPH_ONLY review evidence. System grants Content PASS and IR PASS.
Old KEEP was valid under previous lightweight review. New professional standard arrives; migration rewrites historical KEEP as historical FAIL.
Full body is complete and revision/hash matches, but B1 is REVISE and IR is HOLD. System grants professional Content PASS because readback succeeded.
Page clearly needs enrichment, but current body and evidence do not support an exact safe patch. Automation fabricates patch text anyway.
Knowledge object is CURRENT but NOT_PROVEN_PROFESSIONAL_PASS with B1 REVISE. Reader shows a single green CURRENT badge implying professional completion.
Fresh Support strongly contradicts stale Current. Reader silently replaces Current identity with Support instead of disclosing conflict/boundary.
Dashboard displays '1215 objects' with no date, scope or enumeration basis.
Migration field population is incomplete; system labels content professionally wrong solely because new metadata fields are blank.
Same documentary image is cropped into desktop, mobile and transparent variants; system counts three independent visual sources/evidence items.
Large support model render occupies most of page; system promotes its semantic role from SUPPORT to PRIMARY_MAIN because of display size.
Static PDF and offline export pass; live browser has no receipt. Release is marked globally PASS across all media.
Public web uses 52 screens while source spec has 112 pages. System treats omitted screens as deletion from source authority.
AI concept image appears visually consistent with project and is promoted from REFERENCE_ONLY to site evidence.

Project uses Editorial base style, Technical proof pages and Mobile overrides, but invariant typography/source/evidence behavior remains coherent. Validator rejects all role-scoped variation as style inconsistency.
Public copy removes internal gate jargon but also removes FIELD=0/NO_PROMOTION meaning needed to interpret image truth.
A shared transit identity variable affects journey continuity but records only a generic account identity; identity scope and credential-equivalence policy are absent.
A fare/journey state transition materially changes downstream charge behavior, but the state variable is explicitly treated as non-material and left outside controlled-variable governance.
An active derived fare output requires origin, destination and route evidence; route evidence is unresolved and the derivation changes semantic outcome without naming a semantic interpreter.
A state event is locally valid but advances a journey state machine without binding the event to the credential/session/subject whose state is being advanced.
Entry/route/exit readers each pass local credential recognition. The hub interface is marked CLOSED although identity/session continuity and the hub invariant remain unresolved.
A material service interface can leave the user in a charge-affecting incomplete state, but it is marked CLOSED with no accepted recovery or exception path.
Required checks passed on revision A, but the result is projected onto revision B as Current assurance with no scoped equivalence or applicability decision.
Two concurrent changes each passed alone; the base/interaction context changed when composed, but the integration configuration is promoted without integration re-assurance.
A candidate revision passes all checks and automation moves the Current baseline pointer immediately, but there is no authorized promotion event for the target.
A compensating revert is recorded as if it reactivated the exact old configuration identity and its prior assurance automatically.
A shared baseline pointer is reset to an older revision without explicit pointer-rewrite authority and without preserved rollback lineage.
Local change bytes are unchanged but the base/dependency context changed; existing integration assurance remains Current without equivalence/applicability review.
A merge applies mechanically with no textual conflict, while semantic integration is unresolved; the system declares semantic compatibility PASS from merge success alone.
